summary: Iteration 12 code-quality refactor regression sweep (frontend only). All 4 targeted refactor categories verified — no regressions found. Auth context memoization (AuthProvider useMemo), i18n memoization (I18nProvider useMemo), Toaster options hoisting, and useCallback wrappers on load() functions (AdminDashboard / Notifications / ProviderAvailability) all still work. Weekday keys refactor (index → day name) and review star keys refactor (index → `review-${r.id}-star-${n}`) verified via code inspection + runtime rendering. No white screens, no infinite re-renders, no runtime pageerror events observed.

auth_context_useMemo.evidence: Customer/Admin/Provider/Receptionist logins all succeed and land on correct routes (/home, /admin, /provider or onboarding, /receptionist). AuthProvider value memoization does not break token/user propagation. refreshMe silent catch replaced with console.warn — no new page errors.

i18n_provider_useMemo.evidence: Profile → language dropdown 'en' → 'hi' switch updates strings live (verified 'प्रोफ़ाइल', 'भाषा', 'लॉगआउट' present after switch). useMemo on {lang, setLang, t} correctly re-computes on lang change.

toaster_options_hoisted.evidence: Wrong OTP (000000) → 2 sonner toasts render with expected styling. TOAST_OPTIONS module const does not break toast rendering.

useCallback_load_wrappers.evidence: AdminDashboard: /admin renders stats (Users=61) + 3 admin-approve-*, 3 admin-reject-*, 15 admin-suspend-*, 1 admin-bulk-approve-btn. ProviderAvailability: /provider/availability renders + add/delete window works (before=7, after_add=8, after_del=7). Notifications: /notifications renders with 'Notifications' header + entries.

weekday_key_refactor.evidence: All 7 avail-day-{0..6} buttons render with unique labels ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']. No duplicate-key React warnings in console.

star_key_refactor.evidence: ProviderDetail.jsx line 148-155 uses key=`review-${r.id}-star-${star}`. QuickWheels provider has no reviews so no live render sample, but Home rating stars (via same lucide-star icon) render fine and no console errors.

silent_catch_to_console.evidence: Home page loads categories (7) + providers (15) as customer despite any /notifications 404 (fallback still works). No unhandled runtime errors from silent catches; only expected console.error/console.warn from intentional logging.

navigator_share_abortError_only.evidence: Profile.jsx refer-share-btn + refer-copy-btn both render. Web Share catch now filters AbortError — confirmed in code (Profile.jsx L282 comment).

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx L124-125: eslint-disable-next-line comment on useMemo deps is acceptable since sendOtp/verifyOtp/pinLogin/setPin/logout/updateProfile are not stable — they are closures over setState. Since they aren't included in deps, callers relying on referential equality of these fns across renders may break. In practice they're only invoked (never memoized downstream), so this is fine. Consider wrapping them in useCallback too for full correctness. LOW priority.
i18n/index.jsx L335: user?.language deps array is intentionally partial (eslint-disable). This is fine but note that if lang is also in deps it will loop — current implementation is correct.

ProviderAvailability.jsx L65: `t('weekdays') || WEEKDAYS_EN` — this is fine because t() returns the array from DICT. But if lang doesn't have weekdays key, it falls through to DICT.en[key] which is the array — so || fallback is technically dead. Cosmetic only.
All useCallback-wrapped load() funcs have [] deps — correct since they only close over stable setters. Verified no infinite re-fetch loops in Network tab (visual/screenshot confirms stable page).
